title: More results and no related searches on return visits lost revenue

change.control: On returning to results, extend the page to fourteen results with related searches.
change.variant: Extend to twenty results and remove related searches.

sample_size.unit: triggered users; published as over 3 million

significance.reported: Paper describes the revenue reduction among significant metric changes.

quote: There were significant changes to metrics, including: 1.8% reduction in revenue, 30msec slowdown for page load time, 18% reduction in pagination, but abandonment rate did not change statistically significantly (p-value 0.93).
notes: Over 3M triggered users; change not released. Abandonment p=0.93 is not a revenue p-value. All bundled changes retained. Full text is also available in the author-hosted PDF at https://exp-platform.com/Documents/2014%20experimentersRulesOfThumb.pdf. The supporting quote and result were checked against that PDF; the equivalent ACM publisher full-text page returned HTTP 403 in Chromium.
